def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Strip whitespace from text columns
    for c in ['species', 'island', 'sex']:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = df[c].astype(str).str.strip().replace('nan', pd.NA)
    # Fix species typo
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Chinstarp': 'Chinstrap'})
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (sign error)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Fix body_mass_g out of range (likely unit error: mg -> g)
    mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
    df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    counts = df.groupby('island').size()
    return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}
